label: AQ 0043
title: The answer buried in the middle

questions.q: Should the best chunk go last instead of first?
questions.a: It depends on the model. In Liu et al.'s 20-passage test, GPT-3.5-Turbo did better with the answer first (75.8%) than last (63.2%), but Claude-1.3 was level (59.9% and 60.1%) and MPT-30B-Instruct did better last (56.3% against 53.7%). So “best first” is a default to test on your own model, not a measured rule.

teach.title: How it works: what was measured, then what to change

questions.q: The model takes 128,000 tokens. Why not send 50 chunks?
questions.a: In Liu et al.'s open-domain test, 50 passages instead of 20 raised GPT-3.5-Turbo's accuracy by about 1.5% and Claude-1.3's by about 1%, for a prompt 2.5 times longer. And a model's long-context version scored nearly the same as the standard one whenever the input fit both. You pay for tokens the model barely uses.

teach.title: How it works: what was measured, then what to change

questions.a: Our approach: on held-out questions, sweep k, track answer accuracy, tokens and latency, and pick where accuracy stops climbing. Better, cut per question where the reranker's scores drop (also our suggestion); Liu et al. call retrieving fewer when appropriate ranked list truncation.

teach.title: How it works: what was measured, then what to change

questions.q: In Liu et al.'s 20-passage test, how did GPT-3.5-Turbo do with the answer passage in the middle, compared with no passages at all?
questions.a: 53.8% with the answer passage 10th of 20, against 56.1% with no passages. With the answer passage first it scored 75.8%.

teach.title: How it works: what was measured, then what to change

questions.q: Why can retrieval recall keep rising while answer accuracy stays flat?
questions.a: Recall only counts whether the right chunk is somewhere in the set. Accuracy needs the model to find and use it. In Liu et al.'s test, going from 20 to 50 passages added only about 1.5% accuracy for GPT-3.5-Turbo.

teach.title: How it works: what was measured, then what to change

questions.q: Name two changes to a top-10 RAG prompt that follow from the U-shaped curve.
questions.a: Put the most relevant chunk at the start (rerank), and send fewer chunks when the rest score low (truncate the list). Then check both by measuring answer accuracy, not retrieval alone.
